summary: Comprehensive testing of NoteAll investment presentation at /invest route. All 13 slides tested on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) viewports. All features working correctly: navigation (next/prev buttons, dots na-dot-0 through na-dot-12, keyboard arrows), dark navy theme with teal accent (HSL 174 80% 42%), PDF download button, fullscreen button, progress bar. PDF generation works and downloads 'NoteAll_Investment_Presentation.pdf'. Minor console warning 'Buffer is not defined' during PDF generation (known @react-pdf/renderer issue, non-blocking).

minor_warnings.issue: Console shows 'Buffer is not defined' errors during PDF generation
minor_warnings.note: Known issue with @react-pdf/renderer v4.x in browser environments. PDF still generates and downloads correctly. Non-blocking.
